purpose: Microsoft-first validation — confirm proposed modernization uses native M365 capabilities

identity.proposed: Managed identities and service principals for workloads; licensed interactive users for humans; shared mailboxes for organizational communication

collaboration.proposed: Microsoft Teams retained for all active human collaboration

documents.proposed: SharePoint aligned to entity ownership; archive via SharePoint read-only and recycle bin

automation.proposed: Power Automate for business process automation; GitHub Actions for CI/CD via OIDC federation
automation.note: GitHub Actions is Microsoft-owned. OIDC federation is the Microsoft-recommended pattern for GitHub-to-Azure/M365 CI/CD.

data.proposed: Dataverse for structured operational data (pre-need, appointments, agents)

conclusion: All proposed modernization uses existing licensed Microsoft capabilities. No third-party replacements recommended. No new third-party services required.
